about: Setup steps for apps that sign in with the person's own client ID. See ADR 0197.

steps.text: Click Create new app, name it, choose MCP app, then Create app.
Under OAuth, add this redirect URL exactly:
Under Manage distribution, choose Any workspace or pick yours, then Save changes.
Copy the client ID and the client secret.

setups.notes: Asana matches the redirect exactly, so add it again if Spade's port changes.

setups.where_label: Box's guide to the Admin Console

steps.text: In the Box Admin Console, open Integrations, find Box MCP server and click Configure.
Click Add Integration Credentials, name it and save.
Choose the access scopes the bots may use.
Copy the client ID and the client secret.

setups.notes: Only a Box admin can do this, and the credentials work in that admin's enterprise.

steps.text: Create an app, then open Outside Canva and click Start integrating.
Under Configuration, turn on Canva MCP.
Under Redirect URLs, add this one:
Under Credentials, copy the client ID, then Generate secret and copy it.

setups.notes: Canva shows the secret once. Public apps are reviewed by Canva; some tools need Canva Pro.

steps.text: Click Create MCP connector and give it a name.
Set the redirect URL to this one, then Create:
